title: Percolation criteria for merging planar empires
exact_target: Find geometric merger-rate conditions that cause, or prevent, finite-time growth of an unbounded planar empire.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9700021 (AMR-096-0021). CC BY 4.0.
David J. Aldous, \emph{Empires and Percolation}, problem discussed with Vlada Limic in 2001, Process definition and first PROBLEM.
